detail: band-%04d.profiles.bin (80 B ForwardDrizzleV2ProfileResult records, channel-major, same order as pixel records); BandCommit gains profiles_artifact/profiles_bytes/profiles_sha256; both payloads commit atomically inside one band transaction; stores without profiles stay readable

forward_drizzle_v2_cpu.{hpp,cpp}: band-local bounded workspace, affine + local-warp scatter, quality fold, sigma2 accumulation, reservoir, robust clip, profile emission, confidence/support fields; identical kernel interface as the device path

forward_drizzle_v2_driver.{hpp,cpp}: inspect -> adopt committed prefix -> per-band reserve -> accumulate all frames -> finalize -> transactional commit_band -> finish+publish; CUDA attempted when available, any device error discards the unpublished generation and restarts the whole phase on CPU

forward_drizzle_v2_production.{hpp,cpp}: run plan binds source/normalized-cache/quality/sampling/config/source-quality identities; frame provider streams normalized source + sigma2 + quality planes + meta + geometry; sigma2(y,x)=sigma_noise^2+(gx^2+gy^2)*sigma_reg_px^2+half^2/3

fuse_multiband_v2_store_to_image: verifies published store + plan identity, loads channel-major profile records per band, bounded halo windows, adapts to ForwardDrizzleUniformResult, streamed fuse_multiband, writes FITS + optional spool/candidates, reports RA and decoded bands

TC_FORWARD_DRIZZLE_V2=1 selects v2 in FORWARD_DRIZZLE; checkpoint preserves the choice on resume; store under artifacts/forward_drizzle_v2; MULTIBAND auto-detects via current.json; checkpoint records plan_hash + commit_hash; unset env keeps the legacy producer
source_quality_cache_hash added to ForwardDrizzleV2RunPlan; serialized only when non-empty so stores written before the field keep their plan hash
finish() publishes commit.json after the driver returned; the driver now re-reads generation commit.json so commit_hash is populated on fresh commits too

production plan binding, sigma2 plane, CPU/device parity, profile round-trip, band resume, CPU fallback after forced CUDA fault, corrupt artifacts, foreign plan, incomplete store, v2 store->fusion, runner env selection, checkpoint plan hash, legacy preservation

method: 24-frame real-provider wall time scaled linearly by frame count and native canvas pixels; conservative because commit cost is frame-count independent
real_a2_affine_span_geometry_gate: 610 persisted transforms at band_rows=96 satisfy launched amplification <=1.1

reason: old planner consumed the full nominal budget with per-pixel state before adding fixed source/sample/quality buffers
